manifest_row.title: The Auto Industry Wanted Easier Environmental Rules. It Got Chaos.

screening.main_topic: Automakers’ conflict over U.S. vehicle fuel-economy and emissions standards, including California’s agreement with car companies and the Trump administration’s proposed rollback.
screening.climate_relevance: The standards are discussed as a means of reducing greenhouse-gas and tailpipe emissions, and the article explicitly connects clean-car rules to addressing climate change. The dispute over regulatory targets and automakers’ responses is central to the coverage.
screening.reason: Although framed as a corporate and political dispute, the article gives sustained attention to emissions standards, projected greenhouse-gas reductions, electrification, and the climate implications of weakening the rules.
